summary: 32-year-old female hiker injured her upper leg on the Mt. Audubon Trail at ~12,800 ft, ~400 ft below the summit; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and Flight for Life flew her to a Boulder-area hospital after a ~4-hour rescue.
notes: BCSO case #20-3365. Hiking with a friend; RMRG + Indian Peaks Fire Protection District hiked in while Flight for Life inserted rescuers.
